reviewTag: Lakota lines in review with a Lakota reader

landing.text: I'm Emanuel. You can call me Manny. I'm Lakota, and I have a lot of questions about the sky.
landing.reviewer: Lakota reader (named only with her agreement)
landing.source: Manny MVP PRD, draft line C-01

landing.text: In Lakota, the Moon is Haŋwí: “evening light.” A star is Wicahpi.
landing.reviewer: Lakota reader (named only with her agreement)
landing.source: PRD V1.2, section 4a (draft); spellings follow the reviewer

landing.text: There are stories people passed down, and there are stories these machines can help us discover. Come look with me.
landing.reviewer: Lakota reader (named only with her agreement)
landing.source: Manny MVP PRD, draft line C-05
